🔥 The fire settles. Cheyenne has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Maeve says "The fire feels smaller now." David says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. A person, maybe 30s speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Yuki.
📓 Codex: Thornfield split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.

With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

The little star inside Rodrigue goes quiet — and wakes up inside Katarina. Rodrigue never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Katarina will never be hungry again while it hums, and Rodrigue is hungry again, for the first time in a long while.
